CONNECTOR::enable
       Enable all the connectors on chain.

SYNOPSIS
       CONNECTOR::enable

DESCRIPTION
       Enable all the connectors on chain.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENTSSL_DATA {
	    CONNECTOR::enable
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-14.0.0 --First introduced the command.
